description: Exact maximum independent-set cardinality with degree branching and a greedy clique-cover bound.

source.title: Exact Algorithms for Maximum Independent Set
source.algorithm_attribution: The chapter surveys exact maximum-independent-set methods; this bounded clean-room port uses maximum-degree include/exclude branching with its own greedy clique-cover upper bound.
source.implementation_status: clean-room bounded profile; no source code or chapter text copied

input.graph: simple undirected; each edge occurs once

workspace.meaning: Fixed adjacency bit masks and bounded recursion state.

contract.branching: Choose a remaining vertex with maximum degree in the remaining induced graph; explore inclusion before exclusion.
contract.upper_bound: Partition remaining vertices greedily into cliques; an independent set contains at most one vertex from each clique.
contract.edge_validation: Reject loops, repeated undirected edges, out-of-range endpoints, truncation, and trailing words.

oracle_method: The primary oracle uses recursive include/exclude search with a greedy clique-cover bound; an independent oracle enumerates all vertex subsets on the bounded fixture graphs.
